title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About Augment

Logistics is broken. Let's fix it.

We are a team of engineers, product designers, and customer champions building Augie, Augment's AI teammate for supply chain. Augie reasons and acts like a seasoned operator, automating the busywork of quoting, dispatch, tracking, billing, and more for freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors.

Our team has scaled billion-dollar companies, built delightful products, and powered billions in commerce. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and want to define how AI reshapes supply chain, apply today.

Overview

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps team. You'll own our deal desk, support territory planning, and run the reporting our sales leaders rely on every week as we grow from 12 AEs to more than 20. You'll also keep our data clean and handle the day-to-day work behind forecasting, quota administration, and commission calculations. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Operations.

Our GTM Motion

Our motion is outbound-led. SDRs prospect and qualify freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors before AEs run discovery and close. We sell across Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Strategic segments, with six-figure ARR deals and buying committees that span operations, IT, and finance. Your deal desk and reporting work needs to hold up to that complexity.

What You'll Do

  • Own the deal desk: review pricing, discounts, and non-standard terms, route approvals, and make sure every closed deal is booked correctly

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, and Legal so quotes and contracts move fast without surprises

  • Support territory planning: model coverage and capacity, manage account assignments, and keep regions and segments up to date as we roll them out, starting with Distribution

  • Own sales reporting: run the weekly forecast and pipeline reports leadership uses to call the quarter, and build dashboards for pipeline, conversion, bookings, and AE and SDR performance

  • Report contracted ARR and live, billing ARR side by side, and work with Finance so the numbers tie out

  • Keep HubSpot clean and reliable: own data quality, required fields, account ownership, and deal hygiene

  • Calculate commissions and support quota tracking, working with the Director and Finance

  • Help onboard new hires to our sales tools and processes, and document how things work

What We're Looking For

  • 2 to 4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Deal Desk at a B2B SaaS company

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting a deal desk, including pricing approvals and contract review

  • Experience supporting territory planning or account assignment

  • Hands-on CRM admin experience. We're on HubSpot, and experience there is a strong plus

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and comfort with SQL or a BI tool

  • A detail person who cares when the numbers don't match and digs in until they do

  • Clear communication with sales leaders and reps, including pushing back when the data says otherwise

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in logistics, freight, trucking, distribution, or supply chain tech

  • Experience administering commission plans or quota models

  • Familiarity with Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Seamless.ai, Clay, or BI platforms

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Salary + Stock Options

  • Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental Benefits

  • Flexible PTO

  • Monthly stipend

About Augment

At Augment, we set out to create a fully autonomous AI platform that streamlines operations and reclaims the human element in logistics. Our founders recognized a pattern: talented professionals were stuck handling manual data entry, phone calls, and repetitive tasks, instead of focusing on high-impact problem-solving and strategic decision-making.

That insight became our missionâto free logistics professionals from busywork so they can focus on what truly drives business growth. Augment isnât just about efficiency; itâs about transforming an entire industry by empowering teams with AI-driven solutions that make logistics smarter, faster, and more adaptive.

Join us on this journey!

Augment is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity at our company. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Augment complies with federal, state, and local laws regarding equal employment opportunity and reasonable accommodation. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact your recruiter.

We also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable federal, state and local fair-chance / ban-the-box laws (for example, but not limited to, the California Fair Chance Act).

Our hiring process uses AI-powered tools to assist with screening and evaluating applications based on job-related criteria. All AI-assisted outputs are reviewed by human recruiters who make all decisions about which candidates advance in the process.

title: Senior CX Platform Engineer
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our valuesÂ and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500Â® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior CX Platform Engineer, you'll help GitLab's Customer Experience (CX) teams hand real work to artificial intelligence (AI). You'll use Claude Code and GitLab Duo Agent Platform as your default development tools, designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with production testing, security, and shared ownership. This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.

What you'll do

  • Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.
  • Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.
  • Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.
  • Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.
  • Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.
  • Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.
  • Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.
  • Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.
  • Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.
  • Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.
  • Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.
  • Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.
  • Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.

We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.

About the team

CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. We reward leverage, not heroics, and don't leave tools dependent on one person.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time OffÂ 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
